services.EnrichmentService: not built (no enrichment needed for refunds)
services.SupervisorAgent: not built — escalations go to the escalation queue (Phase 3 step 3)

pipeline.reconcile: wired — duplicate events detected by content-hash eventId and skipped
pipeline.cluster_classify: wired — events grouped per refund entity (stable id from ticket_id + order_id)
pipeline.persist_primary: wired — appended to logs/<runId>/world.jsonl before indexing
pipeline.score_measure: not applicable — refunds have no ranking/velocity
pipeline.infer_derived: wired — invariant violations and duplicate payments become alert events
pipeline.persist_edges: implicit — entity carries order_id/ticket_id; no edge store needed yet
pipeline.rebuild_views: wired — entity state recomputed from the log on every read
pipeline.patch_source_items: not applicable — tickets are immutable inputs
pipeline.mark_stale: not wired — no long-lived entities across runs yet
